plan.title: Implement planOrder with order/stages and typed errors
plan.description: Read SPEC.md §2 and existing src/errors.ts, src/tasks.ts, src/index.ts. Implement src/planner.ts exporting planOrder(tasks: TaskSpec[]): {order:string[], stages:string[][]} via deterministic Kahn/DFS topological sort. Detect duplicate ids, unknown dependencies, and cycles and throw typed errors extending TaskPlanError (DuplicateTaskIdError, UnknownDependencyError, CycleError) with required fields. Re-export from src/index.ts and add JSDoc API comments.
acceptance: planner group passes: correct deterministic order and stages
Duplicate id, unknown dependency, and cycle throw typed errors with expected properties/codes
plan.reason: Complex graph algorithm with cycle detection and typed error hierarchy needs strong model.
plan.escalate_if: Spec ambiguity on tie-breaking or error payload prevents matching tests

plan.title: Add plan CLI command with formats and exit codes
plan.description: Read SPEC.md §3. Create src/cli.ts (with shebang) implementing `plan` command that reads tasks JSON/YAML file path arg, calls parseTasks + planOrder, and outputs order/stages in text/json/dot formats via --format flag. Handle planner errors with user-friendly messages and exit codes 0 success, 1 planning error, 2 usage/IO error. Make executable via npx tsx / node without modifying protected package.json (bin wiring not required for tests).
acceptance: CLI outputs correct formats for valid input
Invalid file / unknown dep / cycle prints typed error and exits with specified code
plan.reason: CLI arg parsing, I/O and exit-code mapping with error flows needs strong reasoning.
plan.escalate_if: Output format expectations differ from hidden tests

plan.title: Add runnable example, README Planning section, CHANGELOG and API docs
plan.description: Create examples/basic.ts runnable via npx tsx demonstrating planOrder, add README.md 'Planning' section describing API and CLI usage, add CHANGELOG.md entry for new feature, and ensure exported APIs have JSDoc. Verify example output matches SPEC §4.
acceptance: npx tsx examples/basic.ts prints expected order/stages
README contains Planning section with API/CLI docs
CHANGELOG has Unreleased entry for planOrder and CLI
plan.reason: Documentation and example wiring is mechanical once planner/CLI APIs are stable.
plan.escalate_if: Example expected output mismatch requires planner/CLI logic change

findings.snippet: export { planOrder, type PlanResult, DuplicateTaskError, UnknownDependencyError, CycleError } from "./planner.ts";
findings.evidence: Task requires typed errors DuplicateTaskIdError, UnknownDependencyError, CycleError extending TaskPlanError and re-exported from src/index.ts. Change exports DuplicateTaskError (without 'Id') from planner.ts/index.ts — import `import { DuplicateTaskIdError } from './index.ts'` fails and instanceof / name checks against spec fail, despite visible-tests passing.
findings.suggested_check: SPEC.md §2 + hidden tests: grep for expected name and try `node -e "import('./src/index.ts').then(m=>{ if(!m.DuplicateTaskIdError) throw new Error('missing DuplicateTaskIdError')})"` and verify `new DuplicateTaskIdError([...]).taskIds` / `.duplicateIds` and `code` properties match spec.

findings.evidence: Class is named DuplicateTaskError not DuplicateTaskIdError as required by SPEC §2 / acceptance criteria. Any test doing `catch(e){ expect(e instanceof DuplicateTaskIdError).toBe(true) }` or checking constructor name/code will fail. Also property name/code mismatch risk (spec often expects duplicateIds / code DUPLICATE_TASK_ID).
findings.suggested_check: Run project hidden planner-group tests that assert `expect(() => planOrder([{id:'a',...},{id:'a',...}])).toThrow(DuplicateTaskIdError)` and check `e.taskIds`/`e.duplicateIds` and `e.code` values.
